evidence_rules: 1955–1962 is an explicitly low-confidence pre-association baseline derived only from the ITF-recorded 1963 foundation year.
The 1963 association foundation and inaugural South Pacific Games lawn-tennis participation are separately represented.
The 2001 constitution supports federation capacity for clubs, rankings, tournaments and teams only from 2001 onward.
The 2022 Pacific junior pathway and 2026 OTF profile are current-era signals and are never backcast.
No event result or ranking is a calibration target; long institutional age does not imply high national scale.
